symptom: 4 of 9 probe cases returned reason=hardcap and closed early
rootCause: probe test data: the quiet-period cases armed damageWindowStart at (u - 10f), i.e. 10s before evaluation, so the 4.5s hard cap fired before the 1.2s quiet period could be observed
fix: arm the window at the evaluation origin (startU = u) and add an explicit expectReason assertion ('' / quiet / hardcap) so a cap can never masquerade as a quiet-period close
productImpact: none - the settle predicate itself behaved exactly as specified; only the probe inputs were wrong
